missing_csp.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
missing_csp.remediation: Deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy aligned with application script sources.

missing_hsts.title: Strict transport enforcement not observed
missing_hsts.remediation: Enable Strict-Transport-Security with appropriate max-age and includeSubDomains where applicable.

insecure_transport.title: Transport encryption not enforced
insecure_transport.remediation: Serve the application over encrypted transport and redirect cleartext requests.

missing_x_frame.title: Clickjacking protections missing
missing_x_frame.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors in CSP.

cookie_secure_missing.title: Session cookie missing Secure flag
cookie_secure_missing.remediation: Set Secure and HttpOnly on session cookies; review SameSite policy.

server_disclosure.title: Technology disclosure in headers
server_disclosure.remediation: Remove or genericize Server and X-Powered-By headers.

exposed_api.title: Public API surface reachable
exposed_api.remediation: Review API authentication, authorization, and rate limiting on exposed endpoints.

login_surface.title: Authentication entry point exposed
login_surface.remediation: Enforce MFA, rate limiting, and account lockout on authentication endpoints.
